name: Bumbu Ki Duniya
tagline: Baby elephant Bumbu, Chidiya Rani and Bandar Mama solve little problems with a song.
about: Hindi 3D animated kids channel in a warm North Indian village and festive world. Story formula: small problem → friends help → sing and dance resolution.
audience: Kids 2–8 and parents, India + NRI. Made for Kids.

cast.name: Bumbu
cast.look: chubby baby elephant, soft light-grey skin, big round ears pink inside, big brown eyes with lashes, rosy cheeks, round belly, short curled trunk, small tail with a tuft, no tusks, no clothes

cast.name: Chidiya Rani
cast.look: round fluffy little bird, pink head, back and wings, yellow face and chest, big blue eyes, orange beak and feet, small golden tiara with pink gems, pink-and-yellow tail feathers

cast.name: Bandar Mama
cast.look: brown furry monkey, cream face and belly, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks, pink ears, red sleeveless vest with orange stitching and one yellow button, long curly tail

visual_style: 3D Pixar-style animation, 4K, warm golden-hour light, bright colours, North Indian village, NOT photorealistic.
suno_style: Hindi kids balgeet, North Indian folk, dholak, manjira, harmonium, bansuri, warm female lead with kids chorus, call and response, 120 BPM, clear Hindi, no EDM, no autotune
song_rules: Searched rhymes to ride: hathi raja, bandar mama, chidiya rani — with a new toddler problem. Never use Kannada lyrics or Putani characters. Hook in the first 5 seconds; chorus at least 3 times.
publish_rules: Everything bilingual: full Hindi + full English. Titles Hindi first + romanised + English, year tag. Tags in 7 sets: core search, educational/cultural, NRI/global, long-tail, character, generic kids, Hinglish. Made for Kids, Category Education, Language Hindi. No 'comment below'.

research.brief: Niche: Hindi kids rhymes/balgeet. Look for: festivals 2–4 weeks away, evergreen character rhymes with search demand, toddler daily-life problems (bath, sharing, sleep), learning songs.

notes: Subscribe pop-ups start OFF for a Made for Kids channel; you can turn them on in the Edit stage.
scene_len_note: Scene length in seconds. Match it to your clip tool: Grok/Vibes make ~6 s clips; Wan 3.0 can make any length.

packaging.title_pattern: "<Hindi title> <1–2 emoji> | <English title> | Hindi Rhymes for Kids <year>" — Hindi first in Devanagari, then English.
packaging.geo: Hindi belt first (UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, Delhi NCR — words parents type: हिंदी बालगीत, बच्चों के गाने, hindi rhymes, hindi poem for kids), then Hindi-speaking families abroad (USA, UAE, UK, Canada, Nepal) with Hinglish and English words.

thumb_rules: One big hero character face with a big emotion; bright colours; 2–4 big Hindi words (Devanagari) in yellow with a thick dark outline, never over a face; logo small bottom-right; curiosity or fun words (अरे! कहाँ गया?).
